# WV MetroNews

> West Virginia's premier statewide radio news and sports network delivering breaking news, college and high school athletics coverage, and outdoor recreation content.

WV MetroNews is a comprehensive news and sports media organization serving West Virginia communities through radio broadcasts, podcasts, and digital content. The network features prominent personalities including Chris Lawrence, Tony Caridi, Hoppy Kercheval, and others covering WVU athletics, Marshall sports, high school tournaments, and regional news.

## Sports Coverage

- [Sports - WV MetroNews](https://wvmetronews.com/sports): WVU and high school sports coverage including tournaments
- [WVU Sports - WV MetroNews](https://wvmetronews.com/sports/wvu-sports): West Virginia University Mountaineers athletics and NCAA coverage
- [High School Sports - WV MetroNews](https://wvmetronews.com/sports/high-school-sports): High school basketball and state tournament results coverage
- [Marshall Sports - WV MetroNews](https://wvmetronews.com/sports/marshall-sports): Marshall University athletics and Sun Belt Conference coverage

## Podcasts & Audio Programs

- [Podcasts - WV MetroNews](https://wvmetronews.com/podcast): Directory of MetroNews radio shows and podcast programs
- [MetroNews This Morning](https://wvmetronews.com/podcast/metronews-this-morning): Daily morning news briefing and headlines podcast
- [MetroNews Sportsline](https://wvmetronews.com/podcast/sportsline): Daily West Virginia sports news podcast with Kyle Wiggs
- [3 Guys Before the Game](https://wvmetronews.com/podcast/3-guys-before-the-game): WVU sports talk podcast with Caridi, Howe, and Kercheval
- [High School Game Night](https://wvmetronews.com/podcast/high-school-game-night): High school football and sports coverage with live scores

## Lifestyle & Recreation
